title: Working on a game where you try to convince a Local LLM AI model that reality is a simulation. Every conversation is completely unique!
author: MorphLand
selftext:
A chat sim game where every conversation is different! My game Simulation Simulator is a freeform conversation game where you try to convince your AI best friend that reality is a simulation. Runs a local LLM (Llama 3.1) entirely offline. A chat simulator that's truly organic! 5 different endings, and a 6th secret ending once all 5 are triggered. 

  
I find this to be an actual elegant and obvious use of AI in game development without it ever being slop, but let me know what you think! 

  
Wishlist Simulation Simulator on Steam! Feedback welcome!
